initial_plan.goal_evidence: Red sphere detected at axial depth 3.12m, surface range 3.93m. Appears elevated and distant.
initial_plan.tentative_route: Move forward and slightly upward to close distance while avoiding terrain occlusion. Prioritize forward motion over lateral deviation.
initial_plan.occlusion_hypothesis: Terrain behind visible surfaces is unknown. Red sphere may be on a raised platform or ledge; direct path may be blocked by unseen obstacles.
initial_plan.uncertainty: No depth map beyond visible surfaces. Surface range suggests potential occlusion or elevation change. Motion strategy assumes no hidden geometry.
initial_plan.revision_trigger: If forward motion reveals occlusion or unexpected terrain, or if red sphere disappears from view.

result.arrival_endpoint: automatic 3 consecutive evaluator samples; separate from VLM STOP
